summary: Short kerb with cars parked along it, bush behind; dormitory 58 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind; the only dormitory is 58 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park here; a grass and dirt verge with a path sits beside the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Campus road beside a junction; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars already park along this kerb, so a van blends in.

flags: Sign: No Stopping Any Time (arrow left, 1.5 m from kerb), although cars are parked here
Section is only 18 m, about one van length plus a little
Low-lying: about 9 m elevation, Brisbane River 208 m away
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the south side; open to midday sun from the north.
cannot_judge: Where the No Stopping sign applies

best_section.where: South kerb of Sir William MacGregor Drive, just west of the junction island
